text:
Maria C.: Heads up — planning a deploy to tweak GPU autoscaler policy for dedicated pools tonight at 22:00 PST. Low risk but want a quick smoke check plan. Who's on call?
Simon: I'm around, can pick up deploy and watch the SLOs. Which pool and PR?
Maria C.: pool 'dedicated-gpu-west', PR #842. Change: reduce cooldown from 5m -> 90s and add min_replicas:2 for small workloads. Also tweak scale_up_threshold to 0.65. See snippet below.
Cheng: Can we canary to 10% traffic (pool=canary)? We usually prefer canary first. Also need rollback steps and a quick health script.
Maria C.: Yes canary 10% for 30m. Rollback is `scripts/rollback_pool.sh dedicated-gpu-west` or via infra console "Revert pool config". Tagging @deploy-bot to schedule.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for pool dedicated-gpu-west at 2026-03-17T22:00:00Z, id: db-1768001234. Will post smoke-check link to this thread when live.
Leo: Quick smoke checks: run `make smoke-ping POOL=dedicated-gpu-west` and validate latency p50/p95 < 200ms and GPU utilization < 75%. I'll run the smoke run after deployment.
Anita: I'll watch cost metrics and batching hit-rate. Ping me if quantization looks off.
Simon: PR is approved and merged. I can kick the deploy at 22:00. Will notify in #eng-oncall if anything breaks.
Maria C.: Post-deploy checklist: (1) check canary traces at /console/model-serving?range=30m (2) verify autoscaler events `kubectl get events -n inference | grep autoscaler` (3) confirm fallback policy still intact and old model variants are routable.
Cheng: One more — ensure KV cache config unchanged. If KV cache TTL drops, perf could regress.
Simon: Noted. Will run smoke and then promote if 30m stable. Rollback window 60m. I'll call for rollback if p95 increases > 200ms or errors > 0.5%.
Maria C.: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update the release notes and tag SRE. Snippet of the new autoscaler config:```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 50
  scale_up_threshold: 0.65
  cooldown_seconds: 90
  policy: cpu_and_gpu
```
Simon: I'll paste the logs here after smoke: `deploy.log` tail attached if anything odd.
Leo: If promote goes well, let's roll this config to dedicated-gpu-east tomorrow during the same window.
Maria C.: Agreed. We'll follow the same canary cadence. Thanks everyone.
